## Summary

The custom PCB assembled and validated, the flight controller flashed and
talking to the ESC, and the robot flapping in air under wireless control.

|---|---|
| **Parts** | Seeeduino XIAO, connectors, battery |
| **Tools** | Hotplate, tweezers, multimeter, bench supply with current limit |
| **Read** | This page |
